sources.note: Main website. Describes Avon as 'the only all-in-one EMR and practice management platform.' Lists features including visit notes, care plans, prescriptions, labs, imaging, scheduling, messaging, forms, tasks, RCM, eligibility checks, invoicing, superbills, faxing, patient/caregiver portals, AI scribe, analytics, APIs, and custom code. Claims '100,000+ providers, patients, and high-growth businesses.' ONC, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI compliant.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms Avon EMR 1.0 certified May 14, 2025. Lists 35 certification criteria. Notes EMR Direct and AccessGUDID as additional software. MFA via email/password + SMS OTP. One CQM for depression screening. Monthly per-license pricing with pass-through charges for advanced features.

Product documentation listing all toggleable modules: scheduling, messaging, forms, tasks, care plans, documents, visit notes, AI scribe, courses, e-prescribing, prescription fulfillment, lab orders, mobile phlebotomy, at-home test kits, eligibility checks, e-faxes, invoices, superbills, RCM, Epic integrations, automations.

Documentation hub with guides organized into core features (patient registration, scheduling, messaging, forms, tasks, care plans, documents, visit notes, prescriptions, labs, eligibility), financial management (invoicing, superbills, RCM, fax), advanced features (automations, courses, AI scribe), and configuration (brand settings, billing providers, access controls, integrations).

Scheduling feature page. Details virtual/in-person, one-time/recurring, individual/group sessions. Intelligent provider matching by license, location, availability, time zone. Patient self-scheduling. Automated confirmations/reminders. Integrated video visits and calendar sync.
Analytics feature page. Real-time dashboards for clinical, operational, and financial metrics. Filtering by provider, patient, or date. Drill-down from KPIs to patient-level data. Export and sharing.

Pricing page. Three tiers: Growth ($205/license/mo), Pro ($370/license/mo), Enterprise (custom). Growth includes scheduling, messaging, charting, API, automations. Pro adds AI scribe, AI data analyst, direct messaging, HIE integrations. Enterprise adds dedicated support and custom integrations. E-prescribing, lab orders, eligibility, e-faxing, RCM on pass-through pricing.
LinkedIn profile of Maitreyee Joshi, Founder & CEO. Carnegie Mellon CS. Previously PM at PathAI (ML). Based in New York.
Crunchbase listing (could not access full profile due to 403). Search results indicated company based in New York, NY, founded by Maitreyee Joshi. Sequoia Capital mentioned as supporter.
Confirmed this is a DIFFERENT company/product (AvonEHR) focused on integrative/functional medicine — not related to Avon Health (avonhealth.com).
